question: In January 2023, who has been appointed as the Director General in the Directorate of General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Dev Dutt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Vikram Dev Dutt was appointed as the Director General in the Directorate of General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) in January 2023.
 
• Prior to this appointment, he served as the Chairman and Managing Director of Air India Assets Holding Ltd (AIAHL).
 
• Vikram Dev Dutt is an IAS officer of the 1993 batch from the AGMUT cadre.
 
• He has held various key positions in the government, including roles in the Ministry of Civil Aviation and other important departments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)**

 
 
• The DGCA is the regulatory body in the field of Civil Aviation, primarily dealing with safety issues. It is responsible for the regulation of air transport services to/from/within India and for the enforcement of civil air regulations, air safety, and airworthiness standards.
 
• The DGCA also coordinates all regulatory functions with the International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO).
 
• The headquarters of DGCA is located in New Delhi, India.
 
• It oversees the issuance of licenses to pilots, aircraft maintenance engineers, air traffic controllers, and other personnel, as well as the certification of airports.
 
 
 
• **Air India Assets Holding Ltd (AIAHL)**
 
 
• AIAHL is a special purpose vehicle (SPV) set up by the Government of India to hold the debt and non-core assets of Air India.
 
• The objective of AIAHL is to clean up the financials of Air India before its strategic disinvestment.
 
• The SPV manages and monetizes the assets transferred to it from Air India to repay the liabilities.
 
 
 
• **International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO)**
 
 
• ICAO is a specialized agency of the United Nations, established in 1944 to manage the administration and governance of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention).
 
• It works with the Convention’s 193 Member States and global aviation organizations to develop policies and standards, undertake compliance audits, perform studies and analyses, provide assistance and build aviation capacity through various projects and programs.
 
• ICAO’s mission is to promote the safe and orderly development of international civil aviation worldwide.
